blocks.text: Buying a Single-Family Detached House in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Single-family detached houses form the backbone of Maple Ridge real estate—accounting for over 82% of homes in Silver Valley, 76% in Northwest Maple Ridge, 69% in Southwest Maple Ridge, and over 86% in the rural eastern benchlands. According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® September 2026 MLS® HPI, the benchmark price for a detached house in Maple Ridge is $1,231,900.

Buyers comparing Maple Ridge houses choose between two distinct urban styles: wider 1970s–1990s RS-1 lots in West Central (median 9,032 sq ft lot in Q3 2026), Northwest Maple Ridge (median 7,201 sq ft), and Southwest Maple Ridge (median 7,200 sq ft), or post-2005 two-storey-with-basement family homes on compact lots in Albion (median 3,961 sq ft), Silver Valley (median 5,090 sq ft), and Cottonwood (median 5,995 sq ft).

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019: Suites, Garden Suites & SSMUH

parts.t: Before purchasing a detached house in Maple Ridge, check its exact zoning designation under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 (R-1, R-2, R-3, RS-1, RS-1b, RS-2, or RS-3), verify whether any basement suite or detached garden suite holds final City of Maple Ridge building and occupancy permits, and review provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) infill eligibility on serviced urban lots.

Can I have both a basement suite and a garden suite in Maple Ridge?

Under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 and provincial SSMUH amendments, qualifying single-detached lots inside the Urban Area Boundary with municipal water and sewer can accommodate secondary suites and/or detached garden suites subject to lot coverage, parking, and building permit rules.
Which Maple Ridge houses are in French Immersion school catchments?

Early French Immersion (K-7) in SD42 is offered at Eric Langton Elementary (East Central), Laity View Elementary (West Central), and Golden Ears Elementary (Cottonwood/Albion), feeding into Maple Ridge Secondary (Grades 8-12 French Immersion).
How do I check for steep-slope or creek covenants on a Maple Ridge house?

Many hillside homes in Silver Valley, Albion, and Thornhill carry Section 219 geotechnical or riparian watercourse covenants on title. We pull the BC Land Title Office state of title certificate and covenant instruments before you remove subjects.
